name: Tabard of the Boastful Scoundrel
body:
Price 14,500 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This pure white roll of cotton fabric can be donned as a tabard, bearing the symbol of your family, or a personal symbol if desired. While worn by a character with the challenge or parry and riposte class feature this tabard grants a +2 competence bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sleight of Hand checks. In addition when activating challenge or parry and riposte, your next attack before the end of the current turn gains a bonus to damage and critical confirmation rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. Once per day while wearing the tabard, if you score a critical hit you regain a use of challenge or a point of panache, your choice.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells eagle’s splendor
